hero.title: Haidera Muhannad
hero.description: I build reliable software systems and practical web applications, with a strong focus on backend engineering, implementation quality, and clear user experiences.

about.title: About me
about.paragraphOne: I am a software developer and Computer Engineering Technology student. I gravitate toward systems that solve a real problem: from understanding a workflow and shaping its data, to building the backend and testing the result as a complete product.
about.paragraphTwo: My work includes an enterprise approvals system, an Arabic coding academy, an offline point-of-sale application, and a personal expense tracker. I treat the interface as part of system quality, not as a decorative layer.

projectsSection.title: My projects
projectsSection.description: Four practical products for four different contexts. Understand what each one does, try its simulation here, or open the complete project details.

projects.title: Enterprise Workflow
projects.summary: A system for internal requests and approvals usually handled through paper and email, with dynamic workflows, permissions, notifications, and an audit trail for each action.

projects.title: Coding Academy
projects.summary: An Arabic practice-first platform that begins with clear lesson and summary cards, then moves into examples, exercises, and projects while keeping progress on the learner's device.
projects.previewAlt: Coding Academy lesson and summary cards

projects.title: Mahsoob
projects.summary: An Arabic offline point-of-sale system for groceries, minimarkets, and small Iraqi shops, designed around cashier speed, IQD, and uninterrupted daily work.
projects.previewAlt: Source-faithful simulation of the Mahsoob checkout

projects.title: Masroofi
projects.summary: A personal Arabic app for recording income and expenses and tracking the balance instantly, with local storage plus data backup and restore without requiring an account.
